newsitem.title: INDIA: Fresh consumer buying lifts Indian sugar prices.
newsitem.headline: Fresh consumer buying lifts Indian sugar prices.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Tuesday rose on fresh consumer buying on the local market, dealers said.
In ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by five rupees at 1,425/1,465 rupees per quintal while M-30 looked up by same margin at 1,465/1,495 rupees per quintal.
"Arrivals of sugar from local mills to the Bombay market remained slow following higher outstation demand at the mill level," one broker said.
"Local millers are witnessing higher demand particularly from the southern states," he said.
Sugar mill delivery rose by five rupees at 1,355/1,365 rupees per quintal.
